assertions.subject: Mononeuropathy
assertions.quote: Malignant cells, in particular leukemia and lymphoma, can infiltrate cranial and peripheral nerves, leading to mononeuropathy

assertions.subject: Mononeuropathy

assertions.quote: Neuropathies may develop in patients who undergo bone marrow transplantation (BMT)
